music.label: Music
music.description: Listen to music in voice channels (YouTube, SoundCloud, Spotify…) through a Lavalink server.
music.notConfigured: ❌ Music isn't configured on this host (no Lavalink server).
music.nodeDown: ❌ The Lavalink server is unreachable. Check it's running (`docker compose ps`) and that LAVALINK_HOST / LAVALINK_PASSWORD are correct.
music.joinFailed: ❌ Couldn't join your voice channel (missing Connect / Speak permissions?).
music.playError: ❌ Something went wrong during playback. Try again in a moment.
music.notSameChannel: ❌ You must be in the same voice channel as the bot.
music.noPermission: ❌ Reserved to the DJ role (or “Manage Server”).
music.skippedEnd: ⏭️ Last track skipped, end of the queue.
music.queueTooShort: ❌ Not enough tracks in the queue to shuffle.
music.cannotSeek: ❌ Can't seek in this track (live or missing).

command.play: Play a track or add it to the queue (search or link).
command.playQuery: Title to search or a link (YouTube, SoundCloud…).
command.playSource: Search platform (when it isn't a link).
command.stop: Stop playback and clear the queue.
command.seek: Seek to a position in the track.
command.remove: Remove a track from the queue.
command.disconnect: Disconnect the bot from the voice channel.

djRoleId.label: DJ role (control reserved — empty = everyone)
djRoleId.help: Restricts the commands that affect everyone — skip, stop, clear the queue — to holders of this role. Empty, any member can cut off what the others are listening to.

defaultSearch.label: Default search platform
defaultSearch.help: The platform queried when the request is a title rather than a link. A pasted link is always read as-is, whatever this value. Spotify needs server-side credentials (SPOTIFY_CLIENT_*): without them the search fails quietly and the queue stays empty.

defaultVolume.label: Default volume (1-100)
defaultVolume.help: The volume applied each time the bot connects. Raising it does not improve the sound, only saturate it: above 100 the audio is amplified after mixing.

maxVolume.label: Maximum volume (1-150)
maxVolume.help: The ceiling nobody can go past. It is the guard against the member who jumps to 150 as a joke in a voice channel where everyone is wearing headphones.

requireSameChannel.label: Require being in the same voice channel to control
requireSameChannel.help: Requires being in the same voice channel as the bot to control it. Keep it on: otherwise someone who is not listening can skip other people's tracks from anywhere.

autoLeave.label: Leave automatically when the queue ends
autoLeave.help: The bot leaves the voice channel once the queue runs out, instead of idling there. Keep it on: a bot sitting in a voice channel looks busy to everyone, and holds a connection for nothing.
